title: This is STALKING!  You are STALKING this man!  Let him be!!! #KitConn...
transcript: For me, it's not even the fact that she decided to follow Kit Connor's car home, which, to be clear, is an insane invasion of privacy, but the fact that she then thought it was okay to post online about it and brag about doing it. Like, not only does she not see why what she did was wrong, but she's actively proud of it. That is like, next level mentally unwell. And this isn't even an isolated incident. Like, I have heard stories of people trying to catch actors coming out of a side door that isn't the stage door, or following them down the street. And like, thank god that Kit Connor is a big enough celebrity that he has his own car. Most actors when they leave the show, they just walk right down the street to the subway. And it's just creating this massive safety concern that I feel like at some point the industry as a whole is going to have to do something about, this kind of behavior has been on the rise for the past couple years, to be honest. But until that happens, this is just your reminder that any post show interaction you have with actors begins and ends at the stage door. Once they leave the stage door, or if they go out another exit, just let them be. They do not owe you an interaction and they are allowed to set boundaries. Please respect them.
classificationReason: Commentary about fan behavior and stalking Kit Connor, not about a specific stage production
